title: Setup invites a viewer with a copyable one-time link and revokes their session
description: The served dashboard uses real invite and revoke routes against isolated Postgres: the operator invites sam as viewer, copies the returned link, checks visible role and expiry, redeems it in a fresh browser once, and revokes the session from the retained page list. The section is hidden from the viewer and reload clears the transient list and link. teammate-invite-roles remains regression coverage.

steps.name: Invite and revoke through the served Setup page
